6b3d562f-7966-407f-a423-318d80317efe.quote: The draft left one favored lane on paper — Kira's carry matchup — with the other four read as theirs, and it played out through the offlane: Legion was caught alone at 9, 11.1 and 13.1, and the second and third catches each had an outer tower on the timer (12.4, 13.9). The middle was genuinely ours: the 13.8 fight won 3-1 at their outer tower with Fangtooth banked at 15, Mini Prime at 19 — and the 16.7 0-5 at their river carries the file's own note that it was traded for Mini Prime, a price, not a throw. Both fights we won we cashed, 2 for 2, including Yin's outnumbered 2-0 on Dekker and Lt. Belica at their inhibitor at 23.6. What killed us was starting fights with a timer running: the 1-3 at our own Mini Prime at 19.3 opened 4v5 with Zinx down 32 seconds (pricing Fangtooth and the inner tower at 20.4), the 22.9 2v2 at their inner tower was called the wrong fight with three teammates pinned (our inner fell at 23.2, the inhibitor at 23.5), and the final 0-3 at 25.8 started with Renna down 37 seconds — the Core fell at 26.2. Next game, one rule: while a teammate's death timer runs, we do not start fights — hold, reset, and take the next one 5v5.
